bugs.description: Missing WB->ID bypass path: a distance-2 dependent instruction reads a stale register-file value that the EX forwarding no longer covers (needs a producer, a gap slot, then a consumer).

description: 3-stage, 32-bit pipelined datapath with WB->ID bypass and WB->EX forwarding, checked against a lock-step architectural model; asserts forwarded operands equal architectural register values. NOTE: the safe-variant depth-15 BMC obligation is intentionally expensive (~10 min with z3, non-incremental mode required; incremental z3 stalls) — this benchmark anchors the scalability axis of the suite.
